title: A hex dump
description:
Read every byte of the input with `fgetc` and print it as a hex dump, 16 bytes per line:

```
00000000  48 65 6c 6c 6f 2c 20 43 21 0a 54 61 62 3a 09 0a  |Hello, C!.Tab:..|
00000010  45 6e 64 0a                                      |End.|
00000014
```

- The offset in 8 hex digits (`%08x`), two spaces, then each byte as `%02x` followed by a space. A short last line is padded with 3 spaces for each missing byte so the `|` lines up.
- Then a space, `|`, the bytes as characters (only 32 to 126; anything else is `.`) and `|`.
- After the last line, the total length in 8 hex digits on a line of its own. Empty input prints just `00000000`.
hints: Read into a 16-byte row buffer with `fgetc` until it is full or `EOF`, then print the row; keep a running offset.
For a short last row, print three spaces for every missing byte so the `|` lines up. Finish with the total length in `%08x`.

tests.name: a longer text
tests.stdin: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. {}[]~
